trial_court: Court of Sh. Vaibhav Pratap Singh, Civil Judge, Patiala House Courts, New Delhi, CNR No. DLND03-000336-2022
case_name: Pradeep Kalra vs Ms Nurturing Green Plantation Pvt Ltd

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Pradeep Kalra, Proprietor of World Wide Graphics
parties.respondent_defendant: Ms Nurturing Green Plantation Pvt Ltd, Manu Grover (Director), Annu Grover (Director)

facts_of_case: The plaintiff is the proprietor of World Wide Graphics, which sold goods to the defendants. The defendants did not pay for the goods despite requests and have also allegedly siphoned off money from defendant No.1's account.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party who seeks to rely on electronic documents to prove their case.
legal_principles.held: However, despite service of legal notice via e-mail, Defendants failed to pay the outstanding dues and replied denying their liability and sought time to check their books.

legal_principles.principle: A plaintiff can prove their case by unchallenged evidence.
legal_principles.held: The Learned Counsel for the Plaintiff has argued that the Plaintiff has proved the case by unchallenged evidence.

outcome.final_order: The plaintiff is entitled to recover Rs. 1,29,256/- with pendente lite and future interest ex-pari judgment.

use_for_drafting: drafting a suit for cheque bounce
using Section 138 N.I. Act in a case
preparing a plaint for a proprietor
